description: BU-Bench-style task set adapted for Synapse (real-browser extension agent). Each task adds a 'start_url' so the harness can open a page where the content script is active before the agent starts.

tasks.confirmed_task: Open Google and search for 'open source browser automation'. Then report the title of the first organic result.
tasks.answer: A browser-automation project or documentation page (e.g. Playwright, Puppeteer, or browser-use).

tasks.confirmed_task: Go to wikipedia.org and find the birth year of Ada Lovelace. Report just the year.
Open YouTube and search for 'lofi hip hop'. Confirm search results loaded and report the first video title you see.
tasks.answer: Any lofi hip hop video title from the results page.

tasks.confirmed_task: On GitHub, search for the repository 'facebook/react' and report how many stars it has (open the repo page).
tasks.answer: A star count in the hundreds of thousands (e.g. ~220k+).

tasks.confirmed_task: Open DuckDuckGo and search for 'weather in Tokyo'. Report today's temperature if shown.
tasks.answer: A temperature value in °C or °F for Tokyo.

tasks.confirmed_task: Go to Amazon and search for 'wireless mouse'. Open the first product result and report its product title.
tasks.answer: The title of the first wireless mouse product listing.

tasks.confirmed_task: Open Reddit and search for 'selfhosted'. Report the name of the first community (subreddit) in the results.
tasks.answer: A subreddit name such as r/selfhosted.

tasks.confirmed_task: Search the web for the current CEO of NVIDIA and report their name.
Find out what year the first crewed Moon landing happened, using a web search, and report the year.
Use the web to determine the capital of Australia and report it.
Search the web and report the number of planets in our solar system.
Open example.com and summarize the page in one sentence.
tasks.answer: A sentence describing example.com as a sample web page.
